text:
anya: quick note — while running the mobile sampleapp with DEBUG logs i just saw unredacted user emails and request ids in stdout. not good :grimacing:
jamal: ugh. can you paste the log line?
maria: is this the node or go sdk build? we have slightly different otel hook ordering in mobile wrappers.
anya: node mobile build. repro steps: `yarn start:mobile-debug` -> run signup flow -> check device logs. saw this: ```2024-04-11T12:34:56.789Z DEBUG req=abc123 user_email=jane.doe@example.com event="signup:complete"```
ryan: that's definitely PII in DEBUG. our redact middleware should catch `user_email` keys even at debug level. looks like the scrubber isn't being run before the logger in this path.
maria: sounds like the OpenTelemetry log hook might be registering after logger init in the mobile node bundle. ordering issue. i've seen similar where `otel-hook` is attached in `index.native.js` too late.
anya: @sec-jen tagging for triage/security visibility. can we treat as a P1 for now?
sec-jen: :eyes: thanks @anya. can you confirm if logs were sent remotely (sentry/otlp) or only local device console?
anya: local device console only, but CI reproducible too in `integration/mobile-debug` job — i can trigger.
ci-bot: build 2547 failed: integration/mobile-debug — see https://ci.redwood/2547 for logs (error: scrub assertion failed).
jamal: ok i can reproduce in a bare-min repro. minimal fix: move redact middleware earlier, or make scrubber idempotent and run on `console.*` hook as well.
ryan: also we need parity with Go/Android sdk — go has a scrub pass in its logger wrapper so it never printed emails. node-mobile missed it. add unit + e2e to assert no `@` or `.com` in captured debug output.
maria: i'll open a PR with two things: (1) reorder otel/log init in `mobile/index.native.js`, (2) add a redact middleware before any logger usage and a test in `integration/mobile-debug`.
anya: thank you. while fixing, can we add a feature flag to scrub even in DEBUG so engineers don't leak PII locally? maybe `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS=true`.
sec-jen: yes please. also file an incident ticket and notify customer-support if any customer repros surface.
jamal: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/mobile-sdk/pull/981 — contains changes + test. requesting review from @maria and @ryan.
ryan: reviewing now. small nit about test flakiness but overall LGTM. :thumbsup:
maria: merged to canary. i'll kick a canary rollout to `dev` for the mobile agents and monitor for any failed scrub assertions.
anya: thanks team — once canary looks good, can we ship hotfix to prod mobile image?
sec-jen: agreed, do not ship without the `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS` env toggle set to true in prod by default and a config in console to opt-out for internal dev clusters.
ci-bot: regression test added: `integration/mobile-debug/scrubbed-assert` — passing locally.
anya: closing loop — thanks all, learned: OTEL hook order + logger init parity is subtle and caused the leak. note for onboarding guide: include explicit instruction to init telemetry before any debug helpers. :memo:
